thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike: inference-service 5xx rate > 8% across eu-west-1 for 3m — firing 42 alerts and paging oncall with PD group 'infra-api'.

alex: ack, I'm oncall. seeing a flood of PagerDuty pages. landing console: many short-lived 502/504s from upstream.

cj: +1, getting the same. looks correlated with a surge of long-running requests to /v1/generate on a small subset of hosts.

zoe: I'm seeing queue latencies hit 3s on worker-x and then 502s. suspect the batching proxy is timing out under weird request shapes.

pete: quick mitigation: can we silence the noisy alert rule until we reduce churn? we should avoid paging for transient blips.

alex: doing two things now: 1) put a 30m silence on the PagerDuty escalation for the alert group, 2) flip the alert rule from firing at 3/3 to 5/5 evaluation window to reduce flapping.

alex: /alertmanager silence set --match 'alertname=High5xx,component=inference' --expires 30m — done, silence id: sil-3a7.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rollback-batching-timeout -> 4s -> 10s on proxy-config (deployed to eu-west-1-canaries).

cj: good call. Also recommend adding dedupe/grouping by "fingerprint" (job + instance + route) in Alertmanager so we don't open 40+ incidents for the same underlying problem.

zoe: agree — grouping + inhibition will reduce PD noise. We currently group by job only; need to include route label. Proposed Alertmanager snippet: 
```yaml
group_by: [job, route, severity]
group_wait: 30s
group_interval: 10m
repeat_interval: 4h
```

pete: Also set a per-alert rate limit in Alertmanager (or use dedupe plugin) to cap notification blasts: `max_notifications: 3 per 10m` on that route.

alex: for short-term customer impact assessment: which tenants hit errors? zoe, can you pull top 5 tenants by 5xx count in the last 15m?

zoe: running query now. top-affected: ["acme-corp"] 18% error rate, ["greenstack"] 6%, ["shoply"] 4%. Acme has high traffic so they account for 70% of the noise. no major revenue customers impacted beyond Acme.

cj: this is good to know — we can do more targeted throttling or fallback for the heavy tenant. propose adding a short-circuit for tenants exceeding 20% errors and route them to degraded-mode with shorter context lengths.

alex: next steps (short):
- keep silence in place for 30m (completed)
- update Alertmanager grouping + rate limits (cj)
- roll canary change to increase proxy timeout (deploy-bot -> monitoring)
- create an 'alert-churn' dashboard to track pages/unique-alerts over time (pete/zoe)
- handoff to maya for post-incident tuning & bake plan

maya: I can take post-incident ownership. will run through the rule list and propose threshold changes + `for:` increases where appropriate.

cj: suggested Prometheus rule edits (examples):
```yaml
- alert: High5xx
  expr: sum(rate(http_responses_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[5m])) > 0.08
  for: 10m  # increased from 3m to reduce flapping
  labels:
    severity: page
```

zoe: one more quick mitigation: exclude synthetic/test traffic from the metric by adding `!~"^test-.*"` to tenant label filters. that reduced alert noise in the past.

pete: action item: cobble together a temporary dashboard (grafana) showing: unique_alert_count, pages_per_alert, avg_group_size, top-tenant-5xx. name it `ops/alert-churn`. include a small panel that computes `alerts / unique_groups` to spot multiplier effect.

alex: TL;DR: immediate noise suppressed, canary config change rolling, we will follow up with grouping/rate-limit changes and a post-incident rule tuning. handing to maya for follow-up. thanks all. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: deploy finished: rollback-batching-timeout -> 10s on eu-west-1 canaries; health-checks green on canaries after 120s.

maya: taking over. I'll open a follow-up ticket and include a checklist: 1) create PR for alertmanager grouping change, 2) PR for Prometheus rule `for:` increases, 3) dashboard in grafana, 4) runbook update on when to silence vs tune. tagging pete & cj as owners.

cj: please also add a small automated test to CI that simulates a noisy tenant and asserts alerts don't create >5 PD incidents in 10m.

pete: putting a calendar invite for a 30m post-incident sync at 14:30 UTC to finalize thresholds.

alex: thanks everyone — leaving notes in the incident tracker. handing off paging to maya.

maya: acknowledged, taking the PD oncall. will update progress in this thread and the incident ticket.

alex: offcall. good work.

zoe: note for postmortem: consider adding a metric to track "alerts_merged_per_group" so we can quantify how many alerts consolidated would have prevented a PD page.

cj: +1 — that'll make future tuning decisions data-driven.

maya: created ticket INF-4523 with checklist and assigned owners. linking PRs as they land.

pete: thanks — closing the current silence at 30m unless we need to extend.

incident-bot: Note: this thread contains action items and a follow-up ticket INF-4523. PD escalation will now be on maya.
